scientific_integrity: The universal proof is analytic and the finite standard-library checker is provided independently for reproducibility. This is a self-review, not an independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Only equal unit rim edges and equal positive spoke lengths; not arbitrary weighted wheels. Historical priority is uncertain, particularly the inaccessible full 1982 Chen--Garfinkel generalized-diameter article. Finite code checks are not an infinite proof.
title: Parity-sharp continuous diameters and normalized bottlenecks of metric wheel networks
